### Bible Pathway - August 27
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-aug-27-2013.html
Passage: Jeremiah 48:29
Points:
- God repeatedly cautions against pride, which brought destruction and judgment upon Moab.
- Arrogance blinds people to God's truth and shifts attention from the Lord to self.
- Feeling personal satisfaction in a completed task is good, provided credit is given to God rather than self.
- God does not depend on our assistance to fulfill His sovereign plan, but graciously invites us to participate.
- Daily life should begin with humble prayer and conclude with gratitude for what God has accomplished through us.
